overview.about: The JM Eagle LA Championship brings the LPGA to the historic Wilshire Country Club in the heart of Los Angeles, a classic 1920s parkland course surrounded by the city. It is a rare big-city stop for the women's tour.
overview.nextEvent: The next JM Eagle LA Championship is played at Wilshire Country Club in Los Angeles. The short, tree-lined classic puts a premium on precision in an urban setting.
